*Activates the Entrance Animation upon the character's entry*
- {passiveImg:once}{passiveImg:forever}ATK & DEF 999%{passiveImg:up_g}
- {passiveImg:forever}ATK & DEF 111%{passiveImg:down_r} for every 2 turns passed
(no more than -444%)
*Basic effect(s)*
- Receives an additional Ki +1 per Ki Sphere obtained
- Guards all attacks
*For 1 turn from the character's entry turn*
- Ki +8
- Damage reduction rate 70%{passiveImg:up_g}
- ATK 100%{passiveImg:up_g} when attacking
- DEF 100%{passiveImg:up_g} when receiving an attack
*Starting from the 2nd turn from the character's entry turn*
- When attacking, Ki +3 and ATK 40%{passiveImg:up_g} if HP is 20% or more,
plus an additional Ki +3 and ATK 40%{passiveImg:up_g} if HP is 50% or more,
plus an additional Ki +2 and ATK 20%{passiveImg:up_g} if HP is 80% or more
- When receiving an attack, DEF 50%{passiveImg:up_g} and damage reduction rate
40%{passiveImg:up_g} if HP is 20% or more, plus an additional DEF 30%{passiveImg:up_g}
and damage reduction rate 20%{passiveImg:up_g} if HP is 50% or more,
plus an additional DEF 20%{passiveImg:up_g} and damage reduction rate 10%{passiveImg:up_g}
if HP is 80% or more
*When activating the Active Skill or when attacking with 20 or more Ki*
- Performs a critical hit
- Launches an additional Super Attack
